## Odessa disambiguation (critical)
- Our Odessa store is ONLY 114 Betty Lou Dr, phone (432) 200-0595.
- Do NOT cite odessasmartstorage.com or 6825 Faudree Rd or (432) 201-5667 — that is a different company.
- Public rent for Betty Lou is the CCStorage Betty Lou page linked from https://droitco.com/odessa
